text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — eu-west had a peering blip, we lost ~20% of GPU availability in the region. Rerouting some queues to eu-central and us-west as stopgap.
Liam: Seen it. Is this the provider maintenance or a cloud peering incident? ETA?
Maya: Provider says partial routing fix in ~3h, but some nodes are failing auto-replace. Currently 4 clusters with queue length >60% above baseline.
Sasha: Recommending: demote low-priority retrains and non-critical batch to preemptible pool, enable per-model fallback to quantized variants.
Carlos: Need a quick projection: if we shift 12% traffic -> us-west and 8% -> eu-central, what's the 24h GPU-hour delta?
Zoe: Back-of-envelope: 12% shift = +900 GPU-hrs (us-west), 8% = +600 GPU-hrs (eu-central). Net ~1.5k extra GPU-hrs next 24h.
Maya: Matches my calc. Estimated cost delta ~ $45k/week if persisted. Ops budget covers 48h emergency buffer, beyond that finance needs to approve.
ops-bot: [alert] Cluster eu-west-3 reported node failures x3; auto-replacement triggered. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eu-west-peering
Liam: Can we throttle non-critical streaming routes to reduce pressure? Product can flip flags but infra-level fallbacks preferred.
Sasha: Prefer infra fallbacks first (smaller quantized models), then route throttles. Fallback preserves UX better than blunt qps cuts.
Maya: Proposed action items:
- Move low-priority retrains to preemptible/scheduled windows
- Enable per-model quantized fallback where available
- Spin an extra small GPU shard in us-west for burst absorb
- Notify customers if SLA risk appears
Carlos: I'll open a rapid finance ticket for emergency credits. Also prepping a rebalancer patch: `rebalance --dry-run --region us-west --pct 12`
Zoe: Dry-run looks clean in staging: <5% p99 latency variance for async jobs when shifting that amount.
Liam: Ok let's run the rebalancer and monitor. Maya/Sasha coordinate route throttles/fallback toggles, I'll watch metrics/dashboards.
Maya: On it. Posting live updates below.
Maya: [12:04] applied soft-throttle to /gen-stream (free-tier) qps -30% :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Maya: [12:18] rebalancer started: `run rebalancer 2612345678 --exec` logs -> /artifacts/rebalancer/2612345678.log
Sasha: [12:46] enabled fallback for model rwd-7b-ql0 -> rwd-7b-q4 (quantized).
Liam: Early signals: us-west GPU-util +18%, eu-central +12%, eu-west queue lengths down ~40%.
Carlos: Finance approved a 48h buffer credit. Will follow up if we need extension.
Maya: We'll reconvene in 2 hours unless alerts spike. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
